description: This file defines a utility class AppLogger for initializing and retrieving loggers using the 'logging' package in a Flutter app, with specific configurations based on debug mode.

classes.name: AppLogger
classes.description: A utility class for setting up logging configuration and providing logger instances.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the logging system with a root level based on whether the app is in debug mode, and sets up a listener to print log details to the debug console.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Provides a named Logger instance for use in application code.
